loadingBody: Just a moment while we personalise your wellbeing journey.
createFailed: We couldn't create your programme. Please try again.
readyTip: Tip: turn on daily reminders in Reminder settings.
generating: Creating your personalised 90-day programme. This usually takes one to two minutes, so please keep this page open.

complete.title: You've completed your 90-day programme!
complete.body: That's a real achievement. Keep using what helped you, and start a new programme whenever you'd like continued support.

checkinDone.title: Wellness check-in complete
checkinDone.body: You've already recorded your mood, stress, sleep and energy today. You can continue to today's programme.

setup.title: Create your programme
setup.intro: A few short questions, one step at a time, so we can tailor 90 days of gentle support to you.
setup.name: Your name
setup.ageError: Please enter an age between 18 and 70.
setup.history: Have you experienced mental health difficulties before?
setup.historyNotes: Anything you'd like us to know (optional)
setup.privacy: Your answers are used only to personalise your programme. Your name is never sent to the AI.
setup.footer: Your feelings matter. You're not alone.

wellness.title: Daily wellness check-in
wellness.intro: Take a gentle moment to notice how you are. There are no right answers.
wellness.savedBody: Thank you for checking in today.

mood.title: Mood
mood.question: How are you feeling emotionally today?

stress.title: Stress
stress.question: How much pressure or tension do you feel right now?

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.question: How well did you sleep last night?

energy.title: Energy
energy.question: How much energy do you have today?

day.tasksNote: Do what feels possible today. Every small effort counts.
day.reflectionNote: Take a moment to acknowledge your effort and how you feel.
day.celebrateBody: You've completed today's programme. You're doing an amazing job caring for yourself and your baby.
day.talkTitle: Would you like to talk to someone?
day.talkBody: One of our AI wellbeing consultants can talk with you about your mood, today's tasks or anything on your mind.

1.description: Supports your emotions, stress, adjustment and bonding with evidence-based psychology.
1.firstMessage: Hi, I'm your MumWell perinatal psychologist. How are you feeling after today's activities?

2.firstMessage: Hello, I'm your MumWell wellbeing coach. How did today's tasks feel for you?
